title: v5.1.6 — Combo & Income
message:
Big progression update!

🔥 Combo Streaks — play different games in one session for bonus multiplier (up to ×1.9)
🏦 Bank Interest — earn passive income based on your tier
🏆 Weekly Missions — 3 new challenges every week
📊 Enhanced Stats — per-game win rate bars
🛡️ Soft-lock protection — emergency close button after 20s
🐛 Fixed: scroll lock, Stock Trader sell bug, stats tracking, loss toast
✨ Smoother animations throughout
